events.name: Gear Up & Ride: Your Gateway to Cycling!
events.description: Date: September 2, 2023 Location: R.O.X. Bonifacio Highstreet Inclusions: - R.O.X. Community Shirt - Exclusive FOX products discount - Snacks and Beverage - R.O.X. discount vouchers Requirements: 1. Participants must be at least 18 years old and above 2. Participants must bring their own bike to join the bike out activity 3. Must have no signs and symptoms of Covid prior and on the tour day. 4. Signed waiver Description: Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey into the world of cycling? Our first workshop is designed to turn cycling novices into confident riders. You'll get to grips with cycling basics, understand the nitty-gritty of bike components, and learn how to navigate the roads with grace. Safety is our priority, so we'll ensure you master all the precautions needed for a secure ride. And to wrap it all up? A beginner difficulty ride out where you'll put your newly learned skills to the test! Come, join us as we pedal our way into this thrilling adventure! FOX Exclusive discount - Please expect an email and SMS regarding the exclusive discount for the selected FOX exclusive discount
